name: gymops
description: GymOps monorepo foundation for the Lean MVP.

scripts.test:api: npm run build --workspace @gymops/api && cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://gymops:gymops@localhost:54329/gymops?schema=public playwright test --config tests/api/playwright.config.ts
scripts.db:test:reset: cross-env DATABASE_URL=postgresql://gymops:gymops@localhost:54329/gymops?schema=public prisma migrate reset --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma --force --skip-seed && npm run db:seed
scripts.verify:phase1: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:integration && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui
scripts.verify:phase2: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:integration && npm run test:api
scripts.verify:phase3: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:ui && npm run build:web
scripts.verify:phase4: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test:unit:coverage && npm run test:integration && npm run test:api && npm run test:ui && npm run build:web
